[Everyday AI · Find the unstated assumptions]{.everyday-kicker}

People who know a process often leave out the steps they take for granted. AI can help you test whether someone else could follow the instructions.

## Try the demonstration

Choose a synthetic example, inspect its worked response, then edit the input to build your own prompt. **Worked responses are prewritten, AI-authored illustrations, not live model results.** The browser builds a prompt; run it in your chosen AI tool to get a fresh response.


## What to check

Keep genuine gaps separate from preferences. Verify that the checklist does not fill missing details with plausible but unsupported rules.

This exercise demonstrates a useful way to ask for help, not a guarantee of model accuracy or measured time savings. The examples are invented. A person decides which findings are valid and what to do next.

::: {.callout-tip}
## Reusable instructions

Review these instructions from the perspective of a newcomer. List the specific ambiguities, contradictions and missing dependencies that could stop someone following them. For each, quote the relevant source phrase and ask one concrete clarification question. Then provide a short checklist using only stated instructions, marking unresolved details as To confirm. Do not invent company policy, deadlines, approval authority or system behaviour.
:::

```{=html}
<details class="everyday-prompt">
<summary>Read the first worked example without running the demo</summary>
<p>The first example’s input appears above. Its illustrative response is:</p>
<pre style="white-space: pre-wrap; overflow-wrap: anywhere;">QUESTIONS TO RESOLVE
• “latest file” — Which folder and filename identify the correct reporting period?
• “Remove old rows” — What exact rule defines an old row?
• “save the final version” — Where should the review copy go, and what should it be called?
• “usual reviewers” — Who must review it, and whose approval is needed?
• “before lunch” — What date, time and time zone apply?
• “replace the copy” — Which file should be replaced, and should a previous version be retained?

CHECKLIST
1. Download the file — location and selection rule: To confirm.
2. Remove old rows — removal rule: To confirm.
3. Save the review copy — location and name: To confirm.
4. Send for review — recipients and deadline: To confirm.
5. After approval, replace the reporting copy — approval requirements and target: To confirm.</pre>
</details>
```
